content: Tasɣart n Yahuda
Taqedduḥt i ayt n Yahuda, ɛlaḥsab řaǧat nsen, tekkar-asent ɣar weymir n Idum, řexřa n Ṣin, ɣar ljanub, ař ljanub qaɛ.
Aymir n ljanub tuɣa-t i nitni zi manis iqeṭṭa Řebḥar Ameǧaḥ, zeg yiřes n uqemmum n Řebḥar i dd-itteffɣen ɣar ljanub,
uca iɛeddu xenni ɣar ljanub n Tsunta n Tɣarḍmiwin uca iɛeddu ɣar Ṣin uca ittgeɛɛed zi ljanub n Qadac-Barniɛ, ittekk x Ḥaṣrun u ittgeɛɛad ɣar Addar uca idekkwař ɣar Qarqaɛ
u xenni ittekk x Ɛaṣmun u itteffeɣ ɣar Teɣzart n Miṣra uca ṭṭrufa n weymir ttakkwaḍen ař řebḥar. Wa aqa d aymir n ljanub i kenniw.
Aymir n ccarq aqa-t d Řebḥar Ameǧaḥ ɣar qeṭṭu n L’Urdun u aymir n ccamal zeg yiřes n Řebḥar, zi manis iqeṭṭa L’Urdun
u ssenni ittgeɛɛed weymir ɣar Bayt-Ḥujla uca iɛeddu ɣar ccamal n Bayt-Ɛaraba u xenni ittgeɛɛed ař weẓru n Buhan, mmis n Rubin,

uca ittgeɛɛed weymir zi Dabir zi Teɣzurt n Axur u ittenneḍ ɣar ccamal ɣar Jiljal wenni iǧan ajemmaḍ i webrid n uẓekkwu x idurar n Adummim i iǧan ɣar ljanub n teɣzart u xenni iɛeddu weymir ɣar waman n Ɛayn-Camc uca itteffeɣ ɣar Ɛayn-Rujal.

Zi ssa ittgeɛɛed weymir zi teɣzurt n mmis n Hinnum, ɣar uɣezdis n ljanub n wedrar n n Uyabusi, aqa-t d Urcalim, u aymir yarenni ittgeɛɛed ɣar tqiccat n wedrar wenni iǧan ɣar řɣarb n teɣzurt n mmis n Hinnum tenni iǧan ɣar jjihet n ccamal n uneggaru n teɣzurt n Irafawiyyen.
Zi tqiccat n wedrar immars weymir ɣar tařa n Neftuḥa u iɛeddu ɣar tneddam n idurar n Ifrun u xenni immars weymir ɣar Baɛala, tenni d Qaryat-Yaɛarim.
Zi Baɛala ittakkwaḍ weymir ɣar řɣarb ɣar idurar n Saɛir uca iɛeddu zi ccamal ɣar uɣezdis n wedrar n Yaɛarim, aqa-t d Kasalun, uca ihekkwa ɣar Bayt-Cams u ittekk x Timnah.
Xenni iɛeddu weymir ɣar uɣezdis n ccamal n Ɛaqrun. Xenni immars weymir ɣar Cakrun u ittekk x uɣezdis n wedrar n Baɛla u itteffeɣ ɣar Yabniyil uca ṭṭrufa n weymir takkwaḍen ař řebḥar.
Aymir n řɣarb iɛeddu ař Řebḥar Ameqqran d tma n řebḥar. Wa d aymir n ayt n Yahuda zi marra iɣezdisen, ɛlaḥsab řaǧat nsen.
Maca Kalib, mmis n Yafunni, iwca as ict n tesɣart di řwesṭ n ayt n Yahuda, ɛlaḥsab tawṣeyyet zeg uqemmum n SIDI i Yacuwa, aqa-tt d tandint n Arbaɛ. Arbaɛ tuɣa d babas n Ɛanaq, ixs ad yini Ḥabrun.
Yuẓẓeř Kalib ssenni x třata n iḥenjiren n Ɛanaq: Cicay, Aximan u Talmay, inni dd-ittwaxeřqen i Ɛanaq.
Ssenni igeɛɛed ɣar imezdaɣ n Dabir. Dabir tuɣa qqaren as zic: tandint n Sifr.
Inna Kalib: “Man wen i ɣa iwten tandint n Sifr ad tt iṭṭef, ad as wceɣ yeǧi Axsa d tamɣart!”
Ɛutniyil, mmis n Qanaz, umas n Kalib, iṭṭef i-tt u Kalib iwca as yeǧis Axsa d tamɣart.
Imsar umi nettat tusa-dd ɣar Ɛutniyil, tarra i-t ad ittar ijj n yeyyar x babas uca teḍra x weɣyuř nnes. Kalib isseqsa tt: “Min cem yuɣin?”
Nettat tarra: “Ewc ayi ict n lbaraka, maɣar cek tewcid ayi ict n temmurt tuẓeɣ, xenni ewc ayi uřa d řɛunṣarat n waman!” Uca iwca as řɛunṣarat n nnej d řɛunṣarat n wadday.
Ta d tasɣart n teqbič n ayt n Yahuda, ɛlaḥsab řaǧat nsen.
Tina tuɣa d tineddam iggʷejen n teqbič n ayt n Yahuda, ɣar weymir ak-d Idum di Temmurt n Ljanub: Qabṣiyil d Ɛidar d Yajur
d Qina d Dimuna d Ɛadada
d Qadac d Ḥaṣur d Yitnan
d Zif d Ṭalam d Baɛlut
d Ḥaṣur-Xadata d tneddam n Ḥaṣrun, ta d Ḥaṣur.
Xenni Amam d Camaɛ d Mulada
d Ḥaṣa-Jadda d Ḥacmun d Bayt-Falaṭ
d Ḥaṣar-Cuɛal d Bi’r-Sebɛa d Bizyutiya
d Baɛla d Ɛayyim d Ɛazam,
d Altulad d Kisil d Ḥurma
d Ṣiqlaɣ d Madmanna d Sansanna
d Labayut d Cilḥim d Ɛayn d Rimmun. Marra tineddam aqa atent di tesɛa u-ɛicrin ak-d ředcur nsent.
Di Temmurt Iwaṭan: Icta’ul d Ṣurɛa d Acna
d Zanux d Ɛayn-Jannim d Taffuḥ d Ɛaynam,
d Yarmut d Adullam d Suku d Aziqa
d Caɛarayim d Ɛaditayim d Judayra d Judayratayim. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di arbeɛṭac n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Ṣanan d Ḥadaca d Mijdal-Jad
d Dilan d Miṣfa d Yaqtiyil
d Laxic d Buṣqat d Ɛajlun
d Kabbun d Laḥmas d Kitlic
d Judayrut d Bayt-Dajun d Naɛama d Maqqada. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di seṭṭac n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Libna d Ɛatir d Ɛacan
d Yaftaḥ d Acna d Naṣib
d Qaɛila d Aksib d Marica. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di tesɛa n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Ɛaqrun ak-d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen d ředcur nnes.
Zi Ɛaqrun ař rebḥar, marra min iǧan ɣar uɣezdis n Acdud ak-d ředcur nsen.
Acdud ak-d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen d ředcur nnes, Ɣazza ak-d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen d ředcur nnes ař Taɣzart n Miṣra d Řebḥar Ameqqran ak-d temmurt n tma n řebḥar.
Di Temmurt n Idurar: Camir d Yattir d Suku
d Danna d tendint n Sanna, ta d Dabir,
d Ɛanab d Actimu d Ɛanim
d Jucan d Ḥulun d Jilu. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di ḥiṭac n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Arab d Duma d Acɛan
d Yanum d Bayt-Taffuḥ d Afiqa
d Ḥumṭa d Qaryat-Arbaɛ, tenni d Ḥabrun, d Ṣaɛur. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di tesɛa n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Maɛun d Karmal d Zif d Yuṭa
d Yizraɛil d Yuqdaɛam d Zanuḥ
d Qayin d Jibɛa d Timnah. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di ɛecra n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Ḥalḥul d Bayt-Ṣur d Jadur
d Maɛarat d Bayt-Ɛanut d Iltaqun. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di setta n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Qaryat-Baɛl, aqa-t d Qaryat-Yiɛarim d Rabba. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di tnayen n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Di řexřa Bayt-Ɛaraba d Middin d Sakaka
d Nibcan d tendint n Umeǧaḥ d Ɛayn-Jadi. Marra jmiɛ tuɣa atent di setta n tneddam ak-d ředcur nsent.
Maca ayt n Yahuda war zemmaren ad aẓẓřen x Iyabusiyyen inni d imezdaɣ n Urcalim. X uyenni zeddɣen Iyabusiyyen ɛad ak-d ayt n Yahuda di Urcalim ař ass-a.
